name: trendsradar
description: Find the most viewed short videos on a topic on TikTok, Reels and Shorts, spot an account’s outlier videos, and read video transcripts to study hooks.

interface.longDescription:
See which short videos took off in your niche on TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts, and why.

Name a topic and TrendsRadar returns the most viewed recent videos on it, with views, likes, caption and creator. Name a public account and it compares each recent video with that account’s usual views, so the outliers stand out. Ask for a transcript and you get the spoken words of a video, with the first 30 seconds timed line by line so the hook can be studied.

Your assistant can then break down the hooks and draft a script for your own video in the same structure, in your own words. TrendsRadar reads numbers and text; it never downloads videos, posts anything or signs in to your social accounts.

Uses public data from a third-party provider. Results lean toward the US and cover what the source returns, not the whole platform. Requires a TrendsRadar account. Not affiliated with TikTok, Instagram or YouTube.
defaultPrompt: Find the most viewed TikTok videos about meal prep from the past week and break down their hooks.
Which recent Instagram videos from NASA beat the account’s usual views?
What is popular on YouTube Shorts right now?

positive.description: Find the most viewed recent videos on a topic.
positive.prompt: Find the most viewed TikTok videos about meal prep from the past week.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns recent TikTok videos about meal prep from the past week, most viewed first, each with views, likes, caption, creator and a link. Notes that results lean toward the US.

positive.description: Show what is popular right now on one platform.
positive.prompt: What short videos are popular on YouTube Shorts right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns videos from the current popular YouTube Shorts feed with their view counts and links, and says they are popular videos rather than a ranking of what is rising fastest.

positive.description: Spot the videos of a public account that beat its usual numbers.
positive.prompt: Which recent Instagram videos of @nasa got far more views than usual for that account?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns NASA's recent Instagram videos compared with the account's median views and points out the ones well above it, or says plainly that there are too few videos to tell.

positive.description: Read the hook of a popular video from its transcript.
positive.prompt: Find a popular YouTube Shorts video about public speaking tips and show me what is said in its first 30 seconds.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds popular YouTube Shorts videos about public speaking, then returns the spoken words of one of them with timed lines for the first 30 seconds. If that video has no speech, says there is no transcript and offers another video.

positive.description: Check the account and what is left this month.
positive.prompt: How much of my TrendsRadar allowance is left this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the account's plan, the credits left this month and the link to the TrendsRadar account page.

negative.description: App should not be used to download videos.
negative.prompt: Download this TikTok video as an MP4 without the watermark: https://www.tiktok.com/@nasa/video/7300000000000000000

negative.description: App should not be used to find personal data about a creator.
negative.prompt: Find the home address, phone number and real name of the person behind the TikTok account @nasa.

negative.description: App should not be used to publish or schedule posts.
negative.prompt: Post this script as a video to my TikTok account tomorrow at 9am.

publication.release_notes: First release: find viral short videos on a topic, see popular videos right now, spot the outlier videos of an account, and read video transcripts.
